title: IFA Berlin 2026 - Quick Summary
items: **IFA Berlin runs 4 to 8 September 2026 at Messe Berlin, Messedamm 22.** Private visitors enter Friday from 12:00 to 18:00 and Saturday to Tuesday from 10:00 to 18:00.
**IFA should be the main daytime anchor.** Choose one post-show area: Charlottenburg, Kulturforum/Potsdamer Platz or the historic centre.
Private tickets do not include Berlin public transport and do not include the separate IFA Global Markets trade area.
Check your actual venue entrance, the IFA app and a live BVG or VBB route before travelling to Messe Berlin.
Comfortable shoes, water and a charged phone matter because the exhibition grounds are large.
